outfit.name: 洛茜红兜帽斗篷原作衣装
outfit.prose: her original red hooded cloak with a black lining and angular dark fastenings, an opaque white A-line dress with dark hem trim, a structured black waist cincher and utility belt, short fingerless black gloves and black lace-up armored knee boots with red accents; her wolf ears pass through openings in the raised hood
